items.title: Charles McPherson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 9, 2024 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: And it features David Wong, bassist and Jeb Patton, pianist. And both of whom were with my group.

ctx.x: Yeah. And it features David Wong, bassist and Jeb Patton, pianist. And both of whom were with my group.
I want to ask you about the, not just the writing of it but the arrangement. Way back in ’98 when we spoke you said, “The writing process is the loneliest, most miserable thing.”
